sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER-AIR PATTERN FCST TO BECOME MORE PROGRESSIVE THROUGH PERIOD...AS STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER NERN PAC AMPLIFIES ACROSS BC/WA AND CYCLONE NOW OVER WRN MN DEVOLVES TO OPEN-WAVE TROUGH. BY 02/00Z...TROUGHING RELATED TO LATTER PERTURBATION WILL EXTEND FROM NWRN ONT SSWWD ACROSS UPPER MS VALLEY TO MO THEN SWWD ACROSS OK TO TX PANHANDLE. BASAL VORTICITY MAX OVER TX PANHANDLE AT THAT TIME SHOULD SHIFT SSEWD ACROSS OK TO AR BY 2/12Z. ANOTHER EMBEDDED PERTURBATION NOW OVER CENTRAL PLAINS IS EXPECTED TO PIVOT EWD ACROSS PORTIONS MO/IA/SRN WI BY 2/00Z THEN ENEWD ACROSS PORTIONS INDIANA/OH BY END OF PERIOD. MAIN SFC LOW IS EXPECTED TO MIGRATE EWD FROM MN ACROSS WI...LM AND NRN LOWER MI THROUGH PERIOD. SFC COLD FRONT -- NOW ANALYZED FROM UPPER MS VALLEY SWWD ACROSS PORTIONS IA...CENTRAL KS...SWRN OK AND TX PANHANDLE -- IS FCST TO REACH WRN/CENTRAL IL...SRN MO....WRN AR AND N-CENTRAL/SWRN TX BY 2/00Z. BY 2/12Z...FRONT SHOULD REACH PORTIONS LOWER MI...INDIANA...ERN AR...AND S-CENTRAL/SW TX. FRONT WILL OVERTAKE DRYLINE FROM N-S AS IT SAGS SWD ACROSS W-CENTRAL/SW TX DURING AFTN...BEFORE SFC MOISTURE ADVECTS WWD ACROSS SW TX BEHIND FRONT.

sections.title: MID-SOUTH TO LOWER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP IN ONE OR TWO PRIMARY BANDS ALONG/AHEAD OF SFC COLD FRONT. RESULTING QLCS WITH BOW/LEWP FORMATIONS AND PERHAPS A FEW SUPERCELLS WILL OFFER SVR GUSTS...OCNL LARGE HAIL AND RISK FOR A FEW TORNADOES. FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST MOST FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP SHEAR WILL EXTEND FROM ERN AR NEWD ACROSS PORTIONS INDIANA/WRN OH...WHILE PREFERRED AREA FOR LARGEST LAPSE RATES AND GREATEST BUOYANCY WILL BE OVER MID-SOUTH. MOST FAVORABLE OVERLAP OF PARAMETERS...AND THEREFORE UNCONDITIONAL SVR PROBABILITIES OF ALL MODES...APPEARS TO BE OVER AR/WRN TN/SERN MO/WRN KY AREA...WITH CONCERNS OVER CLOUD COVER/PRECIP PRECLUDING GREATER PROBABILITIES FARTHER N. CONVECTION SHOULD PERSIST INTO EVENING AS REGIME SHIFTS EWD OVER KY/TN AND SEWD INTO PORTIONS NRN MS/NWRN AL...THOUGH SVR POTENTIAL SHOULD DIMINISH OVERNIGHT IN TANDEM WITH LOSS OF OPTIMAL SFC-BASED BUOYANCY.

sections.title: ARKLATEX TO SW TX
sections.text: AS FRONTAL ZONE IMPINGES UPON STRONGLY HEATED AND MOIST WARM-SECTOR AIR MASS THIS AFTN...TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP RAPIDLY WITH DAMAGING HAIL AND SVR GUSTS AS PRIMARY THREATS. RESULTING BAND OF CONVECTION THEN SHOULD SHIFT SEWD WHILE BACKBUILDING DOWN FRONT TOWARD SW TX...WHERE COVERAGE IS MORE UNCERTAIN. TORNADO POTENTIAL...WHILE NON-ZERO...WILL BE TEMPERED BY WEAKNESS OF DEEP SHEAR...LACK OF LOW-LEVEL FLOW...AND RESULTING SMALL HODOGRAPHS. MLCAPE 4000-5000 J/KG IS POSSIBLE GIVEN PRESENCE OF UPPER 60S TO 70S F SFC DEW POINTS IN INFLOW LAYER...VERY STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...AND DEEP BUOYANT LAYER.

sections.title: PORTIONS MAINE
sections.text: BOUNDARY FROM CONVECTION OF PREVIOUS DAY SHOULD RETREAT NWD OR NEWD...PERMITTING FAVORABLE WARM-SECTOR AIR MASS WITH SFC DEW POINTS 60S F TO BE IN PLACE OVER MOST OF AREA PRIOR TO CONVECTIVE INITIATION. ALTHOUGH MID-UPPER SUPPORT WILL BE WEAK...DIURNAL/DIABATIC SFC HEATING SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO WEAK CINH AND MLCAPE TO NEAR 1000 J/KG. THIS AREA ALSO WILL RESIDE UNDER SRN RIM OF 500-300 MB JET...RESULTING IN SOME ENHANCED CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR AND 30-35 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES TO AID IN TSTM ORGANIZATION. ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL ARE POSSIBLE. ..EDWARDS/PETERS.. 06/01/2013

sections.title: TX TO THE OH VALLEY TODAY THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: THE PREVIOUSLY CLOSED MIDLEVEL LOW IS IN THE PROCESS OF EVOLVING INTO AN OPEN WAVE WHICH WILL PROGRESS FROM THE UPPER MS VALLEY AND CENTRAL PLAINS THIS MORNING TO THE GREAT LAKES AND OH VALLEY BY SUNDAY MORNING. AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE LOW WILL DEVELOP EWD FROM ERN MN TO NRN LOWER MI...WHILE A TRAILING COLD FRONT MOVES SEWD ACROSS TX/OK AS WELL AS THE MID MS AND LOWER OH VALLEYS. WHILE THE SURFACE COLD FRONT WILL BE A FOCUS FOR POSSIBLE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT TODAY...THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR HAS BEEN ALTERED SUBSTANTIALLY BY WIDESPREAD OVERNIGHT CONVECTION. THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THE STORMS EXTENDS FROM SE OK ACROSS WRN/NRN AR TO NW TN AND WRN KY...WITH A MORE DIFFUSE CONVECTIVE BOUNDARY/COLD POOL EXTENDING NNEWD ACROSS SE INDIANA AND WRN OH. THE RICHER BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE /DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 70S F/ AND STRONGER INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OF 2000-3000 J PER KG/ IS EXPECTED ALONG AND S OF THE COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM TX TO THE ARKLAMISS TODAY. IT APPEARS THAT THE ONGOING STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO SAG SEWD WITH THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...AND NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE BOUNDARY OR IN THE ADJACENT WARM SECTOR FROM NE TX ACROSS SRN AND ERN AR TO NW

sections.title: TX INTO TN VALLEY
sections.text: A LARGE UPPER TROUGH IS PRESENT TODAY OVER THE CENTRAL U.S. WITH AN ASSOCIATED BAND OF CONVECTION EXTENDING FROM NORTH TX INTO PARTS OF AR/TN/KY. THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO CONTINUE TO SAG SOUTHWARD TODAY WHILE SLOW DAYTIME HEATING OCCURS ACROSS THE REGION. AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD LEAD TO RE-INTENSIFICATION BY EARLY AFTERNOON WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL BE WEAKENING THROUGH THE DAY...SUGGESTING STORMS WILL BE RELATIVELY DISORGANIZED. HOWEVER...MODERATE CAPE VALUES AND SUFFICIENT WESTERLY MID LEVEL WINDS SUGGEST THAT THE STRONGEST STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: MI/OH/NY/PA
sections.text: STRONG HEATING IS OCCURRING TODAY FROM PARTS OF SOUTHEAST LOWER MI INTO OH/PA/NY. SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE TRANSPORTING 60S DEWPOINTS INTO THE REGION...YIELDING AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 2000 J/KG. LOW/MID LEVEL WIND FIELDS WILL BE RELATIVELY STRONG THIS AFTERNOON WITH FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOWING DEEP 30-40 KT SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS. FORCING MECHANISMS OVER THIS REGION ARE HARD TO IDENTIFY...BUT MOST MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST AT LEAST ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP. THOSE STORMS THAT FORM WILL BE CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 06/01/2013

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALIZED DAMAGING WINDS WITH E/SEWD SAGGING QLCS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LEADING EDGE OF QLCS HAS RECENTLY PASSED A JBR-LIT-HOT AXIS WITH ISOLATED MEASURED WIND GUSTS OF 35-40 KT PER METAR/MESONET DATA. 12Z LZK RAOB WAS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG WITHIN A RICHLY BUOYANT AIR MASS. ALTHOUGH DOWNSTREAM INSOLATION APPEARS TO REMAIN LIMITED...A FEW BREAKS IN LOW CLOUD COVERAGE WERE NOTED NEAR THE IMMEDIATE MS VALLEY. EVEN MODEST HEATING COMBINED WITH 30-40 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL SWLYS PER MEMPHIS VWP DATA...SHOULD SUPPORT A CONTINUED RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS. BUT OVERALL ORIENTATION OF THE LINE PARALLELING THE DEEP SHEAR VECTOR MAY LIMIT A MORE SUBSTANTIAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT IN THE NEAR-TERM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON FROM NEAR THE OHIO RIVER SOUTHWARD THROUGH MIDDLE TN. STRONG/LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT BUT MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL COULD ALSO BE POSSIBLE WITH STRONGEST STORMS. TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW LATER TODAY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON IN A WARM/MOIST AIRMASS AHEAD OF A DECAYING EARLY MORNING QLCS OVER WRN KY/TN. AS TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE 70S AND 80S...WEAK DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED WITH 18Z MESOANALYSIS INDICATING SBCAPE VALUES AROUND 1000-1500 J/KG. DEEP LAYER SWLY FLOW HAS ALSO BEEN INCREASING ACROSS THE AREA AS AN UPPER TROUGH OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST TRACKS EWD TOWARD THE MID-MS VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. BULK SHEAR VALUES CURRENTLY ON THE ORDER OF 25-40 KT COUPLED WITH WEAK INSTABILITY COULD ALLOW FOR SOME CELLS TO BRIEFLY BECOME STRONG...PRODUCING MAINLY GUSTY WINDS. AS THE AFTERNOON PROGRESSES AND LAPSE RATES PERHAPS STEEPEN SLIGHTLY...A MARGINAL HAIL THREAT MAY EXIST AS WELL. ADDITIONAL REDEVELOPMENT ALONG AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM S-CNTRL KY SWWD ACROSS MIDDLE TN IS INDICATED BY HI-RES MODEL GUIDANCE. IF THIS OCCURS...A GREATER THREAT FOR SEMI-ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS/CLUSTERS COULD LEAD TO A DAMAGING WIND THREAT. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE SEVERE WW LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LINE OF MULTICELL STORMS FROM NRN AL THROUGH ERN KY WILL POSE A MODEST RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THROUGH EARLY EVENING. ANY SEVERE EVENTS SHOULD REMAIN SPARSE...AND UNLESS TRENDS BEGIN TO INDICATE STORMS WILL BECOME MORE INTENSE...A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF MULTICELL STORMS STRETCHING FROM NCNTRL AL THROUGH ERN KY IS MOVING EAST AT AROUND 25 KT. ONLY MODEST INSTABILITY EXISTS DOWNSTREAM IN THE MOIST WARM SECTOR WHERE TEMPERATURES ARE IN THE UPPER 70S-LOW 80S WITH WEAK LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING MLCAPE FROM 1000-1500 J/KG. MOREOVER...VERTICAL SHEAR IS WEAK /AOB 25KT/ WITH SWLY 20-30 KT DEEP LAYER UNIDIRECTIONAL WINDS. STORMS WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE WEAKLY CAPPED WARM SECTOR INTO THE EARLY EVENING. GIVEN THE MARGINAL ENVIRONMENTAL PARAMETERS...FURTHER INTENSIFICATION/ORGANIZATION APPEARS UNLIKELY...AND ACTIVITY SHOULD BEGIN TO WEAKEN AFTER 01Z AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN THE 22Z-01Z TIME FRAME AND MOVE GENLY SWD WITH A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A WW MAY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO 23Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COLD FRONT WAS LOCATED FROM NERN TX SWWD TO NEAR FST AT 22Z AND CONTINUES TO MOVE SLOWLY SWD. AN ISOLATED TSTM HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED OVER CROCKETT COUNTY ALONG THE FRONT. WITH STRONG DAYTIME HEATING AND DEW POINTS IN THE MID 60S-LOWER 70S...LATE AFTN MLCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 4000 J/KG ARE COMMON. ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS AOB 35 KTS IN THIS AREA...THE PRESENCE OF EXTREME INSTABILITY AND THE LIKELIHOOD OF MERGING OUTFLOWS WILL RESULT IN TSTMS FORMING SWD-MOVING CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. ONCE THIS OCCURS...THE SVR THREAT MAY CONTINUE WELL INTO THE EVENING HOURS GIVEN THE MAGNITUDE OF INSTABILITY. ONE OR MORE WW ISSUANCES MAY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO 23Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS FROM WRN THROUGH NRN NY. A WW WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NECESSARY DUE TO EXPECTED SHORT /TWO HOUR/ DURATION OF SEVERE THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS EXTENDS FROM SERN ONTARIO SWWD THROUGH WRN NY JUST EAST OF BUFFALO. OTHER MORE WIDELY SCATTERED ACTIVITY IS DEVELOPING ACROSS NRN NY WITHIN THE WEAKLY CAPPED WARM SECTOR. THE STORMS OVER WRN NY RESIDE ALONG ERN FRINGE OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT WITHIN ERN PERIPHERY OF AN UPPER TROUGH. EFFECTIVE DEEP LAYER SHEAR RANGES FROM 40 KT OVER WRN NY TO AOB 30 KT FARTHER EAST...WITH MLCAPE FROM 800-1200 J/KG. THIS ENVIRONMENT APPEARS SUFFICIENT FOR STORMS TO BECOME AT LEAST SEMI-ORGANIZED WITH POSSIBLE BOWING SEGMENTS AND MODEST MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION. HOWEVER...SEVERE THREAT APPEARS TO BE DIURNALLY DRIVEN...AND WITH LOSS OF DIABATIC HEATING...STORM INTENSITIES SHOULD BEGIN A GRADUAL DECREASE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR TSTMS MAY DEVELOP IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS ALONG A SWD-MOVING COLD FRONT WITH A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A WW MAY BE NEEDED PRIOR TO 00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST MESOANALYSIS DEPICTS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM FAR NRN LA SWWD TO NEAR HILLSBORO TX...WITH AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTING THE FRONT OVER NERN LA. STRONG DIURNAL HEATING SOUTH OF THE FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS RESULTED IN LATE AFTN MLCAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 2500-3500 J/KG WITH NEGLIGIBLE MLCINH. RELATIVELY LIGHT LOW-MID LEVEL WIND FIELDS HAVE RESULTED IN DEEP-LAYER SHEAR VALUES AOB 30 KTS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. RECENT VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATES SOME ENHANCEMENT TO THE CU FIELD OVER NRN LA. WIDELY SCTD TSTMS MAY DEVELOP ALONG THE FRONT OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH TSTMS MOVING SEWD...POSSIBLY AS SMALL CLUSTERS. STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SVR TSTMS CONTINUE MOVING SWD ACROSS WATCH AREA WITH POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL ISOLATED DEVELOPMENT. CONT WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED SVR TSTMS CONTINUE ACROSS TERRELL...BREWSTER...MASON AND SAN SABA COUNTIES. THESE TSTMS WERE LOCATED ALONG/IN ADVANCE OF A COLD FRONT THAT EXTENDED FROM NEAR SAN SABA TO NEAR ALPINE. THE TERRELL COUNTY STORM HAS EXHIBITED SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS GIVEN THE EXTREME INSTABILITY AND DEVIANT MOTION...AND LIKELY PRODUCED VERY LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. THE ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT OVER THE WW AREA REMAINS STRONGLY UNSTABLE /MLCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG/ AND ANY TSTM WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF SVR WX FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. THEREAFTER...DIURNAL COOLING/INCREASING INHIBITION WILL LESSEN THE OVERALL SVR THREAT WITH TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL DEVELOP SEWD THROUGH NERN LA AND CNTRL MS AND POSE A MODEST THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THROUGH 05Z. TENDENCY SHOULD BE FOR ACTIVITY TO BEGIN AN OVERALL DECREASING TREND AFTER AN HOUR OR TWO...SO A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF STORMS FROM NRN LA THROUGH WRN MS IS MOVING SEWD AT AROUND 20-25 KT. ACTIVITY IS MOVING SOUTH OF THE STRONGER WINDS ALOFT AND 00Z RAOB FROM JACKSON MS INDICATED MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH 2500 J/KG MLCAPE AND AROUND 30 KT 0-6 KM SHEAR...BUT WITH WEAK WINDS IN THE SFC-3 KM LAYER. STEEP /8.9 C/KM/ LAPSE RATES WERE ALSO INDICATED BETWEEN THE SFC AND 3 KM...WHICH IN ADDITION TO MODERATE INSTABILITY AND PW AROUND 1.8 INCHES MAY SUPPORT ISOLATED STRONG TO LOCALIZED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS NEXT COUPLE HOURS. HOWEVER...STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO UNDERGO A GRADUAL DECREASE IN INTENSITY AS THE SFC LAYER COOLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO WITH LONE SUPERCELL MOVING SSWWD INTO REAL AND EDWARDS COUNTIES. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN REMAINING PORTION OF WW 270 REMAINS POSSIBLE...BUT IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED SUPERCELL IS PROPAGATING SSWWD ALONG A SLOWLY SWD MOVING COLD FRONT THROUGH NERN EDWARDS AND IS APPROACHING NRN REAL COUNTY. ATMOSPHERE REMAINS STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. HOWEVER...THE 00Z DEL RIO RAOB INDICATES THAT AS THE SURFACE LAYER COOLS...CONVECTIVE INHIBITION IS UNDERGOING A SUBSTANTIAL INCREASE WHICH SHOULD LEAD TO A GRADUAL DEMISE OF THE STORM. IN THE MEANTIME THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL PERSIST AHEAD OF THIS CELL. OTHER ELEVATED CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING WITHIN THE ZONE OF DEEPER ASCENT WELL BEHIND THE SFC COLD FRONT. HOWEVER...ANY SEVERE THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN SMALL. ..DIAL.. 06/02/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
